description: The same impossible match and catalog with the instance failure handler set to throwException, which is the thrown-failure path section 8.3 names alongside the result and failure-observer paths.

NoMatch.Alternatives.commentary: Alternatives-only root with no default translation, so a predicate miss is NO_MATCHING_ALTERNATIVE rather than MISSING_TRANSLATION.

Res.Failure.commentary: Only CARDINALITY_ONE is declared, so any count French classifies as OTHER throws inside resolution and getResult classifies the attempt as RESOLUTION_FAILURE.

NoMatch.Alternatives.commentary: The fallback candidate misses the same way, so the walk ends in a failure rather than resolving.

Res.Failure.commentary: The fallback candidate is under-declared the same way, so a permissive policy still ends in a failure.
